title: Vanishing Fourier weight above degree one
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Its variance equals its total influence if and only if the sum of its squared Fourier coefficients over subsets of size greater than one is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
